chunks.text: I have been trying to contact RH's customer service with no avail. I received 2 emails that someone in Russia was attempting to log into my account using an iPhone 15. Since their customer service line is useless, and you have to download/log into the app for ANY help, I submitted a request to freeze/delete my account but have received NO HELP! Do not download/use this service unless you want Russian hackers trying to access your accounts...their CS team doesn't seem to care to help. 🤷🏻‍♀️

If you have issues with app you get absolutely no help! I believe I was hacked and now locked out of app and you have to have access to app to get help. How does that work? This company sucks! Do NOT use this company and app!

Do not use this app. I was hacked, and when trying to talk to customer service, they hung up on me when I requested to have my account closed. When trying to reach back hoping it was an accident I got no answer.

Scambase Edit: yea, I'm already working through your very unhelpful support system, trying to unlock my account so I can close it out and be done with you completely. I've been getting scam support calls pretending to be you, so they got my info from you somehow......

warning do not use this company or their app. there is no customer support, if you forget your password if you change device and you need assistance, they tell you to log in to get assistance. it is absolutely impossible they claim suspicious activity if you try to sign in with a different device or you forgot your password, there is no customer support you have to sign in in order to get it if there is such a thing. it is a scam to take your account considerate abandoned and take your money.

While there Identity protection is nothing to laugh at and it's very reliable I cannot say for the customer service I finally was able to recover my account today only to keep getting disconnected 13 times getting transferred to the right agent in about 7 hours only to get the agent for them to not hear me so if you ever had to compromise account just delete it it's not worth the effort contacting customer support

There isn't any way to contact them in the app, such as a chat option. I didn't open an account with them, and they are being difficult about it! Mailed paper letter to me saying my account was approved & use app to log in. How did they get my physical address? - No questions were answered for me. Can't recommend this company.

I've been locked out of it several times even with biometrics, it's almost impossible to get ahold of them once you're locked out of your account through no fault to your own. They have scams going on, or they have scammers that work for them, because I've had Account issues several times with money going missing.And then them claiming that it's a gold account whenever I never activated a gold account safe to say.I'm definitely going to go into a class action against this company

Has a 27/ 7 phone number. But you cannot talk to an actual person. My account got hacked, they were taking unauthorized transactions from my bank account and I could not get help with the problem. It would not let me sign in or talk to anyone about it.
Awful platform. Waited over an hour on hold for these morons to answer the phone. Zero support if something suspicious happens on your account.

It is extremely difficult to contact support. I never signed up for the Gold Membership but they enrolled me and deducted the annual fee from my account without my knowledge. After finally connecting with customer service they are refunding the fee (I cancel the membership). very disappointed in the company as a whole and their lack of customer service. My husband's account was hacked a few months ago and he has provided all information to verify his identity, etc but he has issues!

Absolutely no recourse on hacked accounts. Customer service takes forever to respond. I have taken many precautionary to secure my account with 2fa and so on. So even if they did gain the password, how did they get passed the 2fa. Do not use. They are compromised.

Can't get a hold of no one on the phone. Everything is through the dam app. You will easily get hacked and NO ONE can ever help you!! They escalated all the time but that's it. How can I speak to a LIVE PERSON ON THE PHONE??

CONS 1) app glitch, log you out when you request support call 2) add the same phone multiple times to device list 3) estimate call back say 2 mins but takes more than 10 mins 4) agent keeps going silent and asks many personal info instead of using voice authentication for security, the agent can literally write down all your info to hack you, agent seems to be from outside of US and they have some serious network issues for their VoIP and voice keeps cutting in and out and the agent just hang up

This app is a joke. I used it once a long time ago they locked me out of my account for no apparent reason. so I tried to start a new account mind you this is years later and I have no access to the numbers that I once had or the email and they will not let me start an account because they have my social security number in their system so basically they have just stolen my information and wasted my time thanks for nothing Robin Hood.

Frustrating as hell!! someone hacked into my account, changed the password and contact email, changed the phone number and kicked me completely out of the account. no matter what I do to try to even report it to the company requires me to log in. the only phone number is garbage. I've had all my money stolen by now and I still can't report it....edit...the support is worse than terrible, I have had no way to even get a hold of anyone about this fraud on my account...,4 days later!!

There customer support is terrible. I have reached out for help multiple times because someone got access to my account using my old phone number and now they are trying to charge my bank account... After trying to get ahold of the for weeks I finally got back in.. changed review to 3 stars.

I tried to start my account but someone else with an unknown email had used my personal info to create an account previously. Filed a police report&FCC report and yet when I reached out to customer service to try to resolve the issue they'd already closed the complaint and said I'd have to start all over. So difficult to get ahold of a human to help with this. They keep sending my husband letters in the mail saying they'll have to start charging his account, which he has NEVER been able access!

I have installed this app a few tines. have had difficulty trying to login several times. Just yesterday I received a text saying someone tried to login to my account and ifnit wasn't me to call this number listed in my text. I did 3 times. 3 tines they hung up on me and 3rd tine it just rang. So my advice don't get this app it isn't worth the trouble. I could never even get logged into the app ever!!!

would give a half star if I could. trash customer service. got a random login in my account, try to log in, had to change password, requires a secondary certification and the AI can't recognize anything. call customer service and it's just a computer spouting nonsense with no actual options to speak to a person. insecure and recovery is virtually impossible.

Don't trust this site. I called customer service multiple times because I get notifications that my account is not safe anymore and that somebody is trying to get access and they keep saying ok is fixed but then a few months go by and I get the notification again. I barely even use it, I made 1 investment to test out the app and this is what I get. I wish I can delete the account, but all I was able to do is "deactivate it".

I sat on hold for 3 hours. A little excessive. First person I talked to was great and helped me as much as she was able, but when she put me on hold because my issue needed to be helped by a different team I sat for hours waiting for anyone to pick up. All I was trying to do was create an account, but apparently, someone else was able to set up an account using my information.

this is the worst app I've ever had, it has locked me out. customer service sucks they don't answer their phone you can spend two and a half hours on the phone for them to call you back and they don't. I can't even deactivate my account because it's compromised by somebody else. I don't recommend this app or this service to anybody.

Worst company ever, worst app ever. I'm not sure how they stay in business , security paralysis will not let you purchase or sell for security reasons that never get fixed. Contacted support again after they offer to resolve the account issue. They failed to reply or repair the issue . I'm done with this this app and company. Customer service zero stars. Account sercurity zero stars PayPal great customer service and good account security

They allow people to steal your personal information like your social security number and refuse to do anything about it. They have not contacted me back about my investigation, and it's almost been a year. i would really recommend you check to see if there is an account associated with any of your personal information. eddit: I've tried contacting you guys using emails.You guys have blocked me but you have not blocked my social security number for some odd reason.

It just gets worse. 5 days straight trying to get ahold of customer support. Finally, 6 days later at 6am on a sunday morning they called. They couldn't answer my question, so back in the loop for another round of battle with the chatbot. I could not secure my account because I got a new phone & they send a verification code to device you no longer have. My account was hacked and they say it's my fault. I am one of thousands of people going through this. How are they allowed to stay in business.

Terrible company- I have someone logging into my account asking to change the email. When I called the Security team I was hung up on three times- WILL NEVER INVEST WITH YOU AGAIN. I WILL ALSO LET EVERYONE I KNOW THAT YOU DO NOT CARE ABOUT SECURITY!!!!!!!!!!

no wonder gamestop caused such a mess they can't even look up your account for you if you lose you phone and login id- they get your social and address and everything then can't do nothing they are terrible people

Received an email that someone opened an account using my info. Called the contact page and was immediately routed to the worst programmed bot I've ever seen. Impossible to report on the options listed given that you have to 1) Login to the account to report issues, 2) Be on the same phone associated with the account to lock it, or 3) Have very specific non-scam related options they can deal with instead. This company is a farce and should be ashamed.

Account got hacked and they won't close because I did some stupid promo that I never used that has literally zero value but because it could in the future they can't close it. And I have unknown devices showing as accessing my account and they will not do anything to remove the unauthorized devices from my account. So don't use this if you value your online security at all
